title: Echinate
summary: ECH'INATE ECH'INATED, adjective [Latin echinum, a hedgehog.] Set with prickles, prickly, like a hedgehog; having sharp points; bristled; as an echinated pericarp. Echinated pyrites, in mineralogy.
